dedupe_keys.name: statistikmyndigheten scb statistiska centralbyran electricity datasets

description: Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. Coverage: Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Användning av el i elpannor efter näringsgren, MWh. Kvartal 2009K1 - 2; Bränsleanvändning och tillförd el inom el-, gas- och värmeverk. Kvarta; Bruttoöverföring av el till och från andra länder. Månad 2019M01 - 202; Nettoproduktion av el, bränsleanvändning samt verkningsgrad fördelat p. Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
